name: PE3 Perth

address.note: Equinix press release: PE3 'will be located adjacent to the PE2 IBX ... with a planned secure link bridge connecting the two facilities'; the street number comes from listings and master.csv

postcode.note: from the master.csv address '37 Lemnos Street, Shenton Park WA 6008' and the geocoder match (PointAddress); none of the sources read gives the postcode

lat.note: Geocoded 2026-09-27 from '37 Lemnos Street, Shenton Park WA 6008' with the ArcGIS World Geocoder (PointAddress, score 100). Cross-check: the OpenStreetMap building footprint ('37, Lemnos Street, Shenton Park, Perth, Western Australia, 6') is 187m away.

builder.note: FineForm: 'Fineform has partnered with ICON Construction ... to assist in the construction of Equinix PE3 data centre in Shenton Park'. IPS (source 5) says the contractor was engaged under a D&C GMP agreement, with major plant supplied directly by Equinix; IPS was Project Construction Manager and Superintendent.

developer.note: client entity per IPS: Equinix Australia National Pty Ltd

mw_it.note: not published by Equinix (press release gives only cabinets/m2). DC Atlas estimates ~3 MW live (source 6). Full build per IPS: 12,000 m2 GFA, 1,720 cabinets across 6 data halls; press release says 1,650 cabinets / >10,600 m2 colocation

cost_aud_m.note: phase 1: US$54 million = A$71.7m (ARN, Dec 2021); the Nov 2020 press release converted it as 'approximately A$76.6 million'; IPS gives 'Value: $80M AUD (total project cost)'

reference.note: DA (City of Nedlands / DAP) not found

construction_start.note: IPS project page 'Year: 2020-2022 (completed 2022)'; announced 9 Nov 2020 (source 7); exact start date not found

construction_end.note: phase 1 launched 9 Dec 2021 (ARN, 9 Dec 2021: 700 cabinets, >1,830 m2; press release had planned 650 cabinets, target Q4 2021). IPS says the project was completed in 2022.

open_questions: scope: MW not published, DC Atlas est. ~3 MW live; may be under 5 MW
planning approval not found (DAP/local government for 37 Lemnos St not identified)
